comment: The agent manifest. A static host cannot list a directory, so this file IS the directory listing: add a folder under public/agents/ and add its name here, or the app will never fetch it. SHIPPING AN AGENT TAKES THREE STEPS, NOT TWO: (1) write public/agents/<name>/agent.md, (2) add "<name>" to the agents array below, and (3) add it to the SHIPPED table in crates/agent/tests/prompt.rs, which is a compiled-in list of every shipped agent (include_str! needs a literal path) and the thing that makes the class tests there examine yours. Do only the first two and `cargo test --workspace` exits 101 on that table, which is the tripwire working: an agent nobody's prompt test ever reads is the failure it exists to prevent. The roster today is two agents, and the second is not a copy of a stage of the first. `main` is the agent this page talks to, and it walks a `critique` stage: the same model, in the same window, reading back a turn it still believes in, producing prose for the person. `critic` is a different job — a separate Worker with a separate prompt that never saw the conversation, whose first line is read MECHANICALLY (crates/agent/src/critic.rs), and whose non-pass stops the turn reporting itself as answered. The stage improves the ANSWER and cannot gate it; the agent gates it and cannot improve it. A model marking its own homework is not a gate, for the same reason crates/agent/src/passes.rs never asks a model whether it is finished. Compaction is neither of them: it builds its own sheet (crates/agent/src/window.rs) and needs no agent at all.
